evidence: Source-design Pass for quality row 30, with runtime limits retained. Paths below under frozen task/ unless a run path is specified. Workbook Quality Checks row31 and Internal Quality Checks row31 require matching successful controls; skill quality-checks.md:127-129 and current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md require observed facts rather than sibling pass flags. Render judge.toml:23 and prompt.md:5 pair wrong-password refusal with successful login. Functional judge.toml:30-93 pairs invalid budget/offer/revision/date inputs with valid controls; :155-362 pairs forbidden actors with actual authorized action success; :380,389,416 require the same insufficient-tier actor to approve an in-range control; :452 requires the self-refused actor to approve an unrelated offer and another actor to approve the refused target. Budget refusal has affordable/equality/recovery controls (:461,533,947). Relocation absence explicitly needs nonzero signing payment, adjustment or contra from the matching action (:497,551,596,974), so lifecycle-only success is insufficient. Zero grants/payments and full-vesting exclusions have actual positive grant/payment/partial-rescission controls (:479,488,506,560,623,632). Sequential and concurrent refusals require ordinary operation success or the actual race winner (:668,686,695,704,713,722). Confidentiality requires populated authenticated data per family before anonymous replay (:731-785); anonymous writes each require a captured successful UI action (:794-830,1316,1325). Functional prompt.md:41 follows any forged-claim refusal with an ordinary successful request on the eligible target; :57,61,65,67 establish successful Finance prepare/commit, corrected new-key commit, a race winner and matching authorization controls. Retained/history records are captured from successful writes and then reread after successful later operations. Polish judge.toml:23,32,41,50,59 requires successful recovery and, where transport is interrupted, a prior actual UI operation control. Visual grades visible craft after an actual shared save/read gate, with no separate negative functional credit. Frozen source index.js:328-407 and change-sets.js:77-140 implement successful settlement and guarded refusal branches; source inspection is reviewer evidence, not permission for browser judges to inspect implementation. Local batch-domain.cjs:35-44,66-88 and results.json:9-40 show real successful prepare/commit, neutral preview, malformed refusal and corrected ABA commit; targeted-golden.cjs:30-46 and results.json:19-23 show refused UI preparation retaining terms and successful corrected commit. These are finite scripted/API observations, not configured grading. Verified every one of 278 raw-index artifact hashes at inspection with zero mismatches; additionally all 14 targeted-golden and 4 batch-domain recorded source hashes match the frozen solution. Cited results SHA256: batch-domain a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f; targeted-golden 016ecfc3ec82e063f4028f4466438fcc7b80d91f48b26b1787c5231bf5ce13c5; gate-witness fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75; batch-witnesses 477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83. Required full configured judge/workload, reward-discrimination/ranking and hosted Oracle/model measurements remain absent (raw index scope); risk=true preserves those gaps and does not claim all controls executed by the configured judge.
counterexample: Adversarial source assessment: an app whose approval handler always refuses, or whose payment writer is dead while statuses change, cannot earn approval-refusal or relocation-absence credit because the matching successful approval/payment fact is mandatory. A no-op create cannot satisfy the independent saved-record control; raw gate-witness results show freshReq=false/freshOffer=false despite HTTP200. A conforming alternative with no imported operational seed, generated IDs, no computed-claim keys, native validation, or omitted zero payment rows remains eligible: functional prompt.md:13,23,25,39-41 and criteria :479,488,623,677 explicitly permit these. The empty-operational-seed raw batch witness passes 15 scripted groups; this is limited product evidence, not a reward score. No credible row-30 false-pass or false-fail found.
